review:
All Lucky Clovers is a classic 100-line fruit slot with lucky charms. There are two scatters: three or more horseshoes pay in any position, while three diamonds on reels 1, 3 and 4 award a win.

The wild substitutes for regular symbols and can expand to fill its reel, completing several lines at once. After any base-game win, an optional card gamble lets you guess a colour or suit to double the prize. BGaming rates it very high volatility, surprisingly for a classic layout, with a 3,000x maximum. The 97% RTP is strong. It's a no-frills game best suited to players who like traditional symbols and many lines.
